race.description: Inglis Xtra Bonus Showcase Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: KINDUKU (2) was backed from $2.00 into $1.85 on debut last start over 1300m at Corowa but just came up short after coming from midfield on the turn. Back in trip but the blinkers go on which should sharpen him up. Great chance to open the account. TO DUBAI WE GO (11) settled worse than midfield before making late inroads to finish a close fifth last time out over 1400m at Wagga. Another key runner who is coming back in distance but gets the shades on for the first time. Hard to hold out. PASIFAE (12) is a new arrival in the Nick Olive yard and is back from a 27-week spell. Ran a couple of nice races at the tail end of last prep. The change in scenery could do the trick. SOUTHERN GRACE (7) returned in good order at Hawkesbury recently and will find this easier. THE MAJOR (1) is a progressive four-year-old who can dictate terms and might prove tough to catch.
